pares.notas: Triple stack: Playfair Display 900 tracking-tighter leading-[0.9] for heroes (text-5xl–text-6xl breaks words graphically). Source Serif 4 300–600 for body legibility. JetBrains Mono 400–500 uppercase tracking-widest for tags/dates/labels. NO UI sans-serif — 100% serif/mono.

pares.idealPara: Developer tools, fintech/trading, AI dashboards, streaming platforms, high-end productivity apps
pares.notas: Single-family precision system: Inter 700 (-1.5 tracking) for Display 48pt; Inter 600 (-0.5 tracking) for H1 32pt / H2 24pt; Inter 400 for body 16pt; Inter 500 uppercase +1.2 tracking for labels/mono. Gradient text via mask-view + react-native-linear-gradient (#FFFFFF → rgba(255,255,255,0.7)) on major headers.

pares.idealPara: B2B SaaS mobile, fintech apps, analytics dashboards, marketing tools, operations platforms
pares.notas: Tri-stack: Calistoga (adds human warmth) for heroes 36–42pt leading-1.1; Inter 400–600 for body/UI 16–18pt; JetBrains Mono 12pt uppercase tracking-[1.5] for data labels and section badges. Scale: Hero 36–42pt, Section H2 28–32pt, Body 16–18pt, Label 12pt. Avoid italic Calistoga except editorial callouts.

pares.idealPara: Developer tools, Web3/blockchain apps, hacker aesthetic, sci-fi games, ARG, security tools, geek-culture portfolios
pares.notas: Single monospace system: use ONLY JetBrains Mono (or SpaceMono-Regular as system fallback). Strict sizes: 12pt / 14pt / 16pt only — no in-between. Weight: 400 normal (bold ruins mono character). Line height: 1.2x font size for information density. Letter spacing: normal (monospaced auto-spacing). All UI labels uppercase. ASCII borders and text-based progress bars.

pares.idealPara: Music/culture apps, sports platforms, brand flagship mobile, performance dashboards, underground product drops
pares.notas: Dominant single-family system: Space Grotesk 700 for display, with 400–600 available for body and supporting hierarchy. Scale: Hero 60–120pt (windowWidth/375*size), Section 40–50pt, Card titles 28–32pt, Body 18–20pt, Labels 12pt. ALL display/buttons/nav: UPPERCASE, letterSpacing -1 (large) / +2 (labels), lineHeight 0.9–1.1x. Use a sans-serif system fallback. Font scale must use PixelRatio helper for responsive sizing.

pares.idealPara: Cross-platform apps, dashboards, system UI, onboarding, marketing pages, informational apps, icon-heavy interfaces
pares.notas: System-first strategy: Inter as primary, falls back to system SF/Roboto on iOS/Android. Scale: Headlines fontWeight 800 letterSpacing -0.5; Subheadings fontWeight 600 fontSize 18; Body fontWeight 400 lineHeight 24; Labels fontWeight 700 uppercase letterSpacing 1. Thick weights carry all hierarchy since there are no shadows. Use aggressive size contrast (poster rule: body 16pt vs headline 40pt+). Avoid italic.

pares.idealPara: Android apps, cross-platform tools, productivity software, data-heavy B2B dashboards, enterprise mobile
pares.notas: MD3 type scale: Display Large 56px/400/64px. Headline Large 32px/500/40px. Title Large 22px/500/28px. Body Large 16px/400/24px. Label Medium 12px/500/16px. Buttons and Labels: letterSpacing 0.1px. Use system Roboto on Android; load from Google Fonts for iOS parity. Never use custom weights beyond 300–700.

pares.idealPara: Creative tools, Gen-Z marketing, e-commerce for youth culture, content portfolios, collage-style apps
pares.notas: Single-weight system using the loaded Space Grotesk 700 (Bold). Display: 48–64px. Heading: 24–32px. Body: 18–20px for deliberate brutalist density. Labels: 14px ALL CAPS letterSpacing 2. All buttons and navigation: uppercase. Use a bold sans-serif system fallback. No italic or thin weights.

pares.idealPara: Creative brand flagships, reading platforms, event apps, flash pages, luxury mobile experiences
pares.notas: Tri-stack: Inter 600–800 for UI and display type (letterSpacing -1.5px heroes, -0.5px subheads). Playfair Display Italic only for pull quotes. JetBrains Mono for labels and stats. Suggested scale: 12px labels, 16px body, 22px subhead, 32px section, 40px H2, 56px H1, 72px hero statement. Use lineHeight 1.1 for headlines and 1.6 for body. Keep text links visibly identifiable; do not replace button semantics with styled underlines.

pares.idealPara: Knowledge management apps, scholarly reading tools, personal brand portfolios, RPG games, cultural community platforms
pares.notas: Triple-stack: Cormorant Garamond Medium for all headings (32–40px tight leading). Crimson Pro Regular for body reading text (16–18px, lineHeight 24–26px). Cinzel SemiBold for ALL-CAPS labels, overlines, section prefixes (10–12px, letterSpacing 2–3px). Drop caps: first letter 60px Cinzel in Brass #C9A962. Section prefix: VOLUME I/II/III in Cinzel 10px. NO sans-serif anywhere.

pares.idealPara: Gaming companion apps, fintech/crypto, data visualization, dark brand apps, cyberpunk narrative games
pares.notas: Dual-stack: Orbitron 700–900 for H1 (42px uppercase letterSpacing 4, fontWeight 900). JetBrains Mono 400–500 for all body/data text (14px letterSpacing 1). Labels: 10px uppercase opacity 0.7. Heading scale aggressive: H1 42px, H2 28px, Section 20px. Body 14px monospace only. NO mixed sans-serif. Fallback: monospace system font. Orbitron requires loading — use NativeWind or useFonts hook.

pares.nome: Web3 Bitcoin DeFi (Space Grotesk + Inter + Mono)
pares.idealPara: DeFi protocols and wallets, NFT platforms, metaverse social apps, high-tech brand landing pages
pares.notas: Tri-stack: Space Grotesk 600–700 for headings (geometric, technical character). Inter 400–600 for all body and UI text (high legibility). JetBrains Mono Medium for all data/stats/prices/hashes (technical accuracy). Buttons: Inter Bold uppercase letterSpacing 1.5. Balance figures use MaskedView gradient text (orange→gold). Heading scale: H1 36–42px, H2 24–28px, body 16–18px, mono labels 12–14px.

pares.idealPara: Children education apps, teen social, brand mascot apps, creative tools, fintech gamification
pares.notas: Dual-stack: Nunito Black (900) or ExtraBold (800) for ALL headings — rounded terminals are mandatory. DM Sans Medium (500) for body text — clean and geometric. Scale: Hero 48px lineHeight 52 letterSpacing -1. Section Title 32px lineHeight 38. Card Title 22px lineHeight 28. Body 16px lineHeight 24. Never use Nunito for body text (too decorative at small sizes). Never use weights below 700 for any heading. includeFontPadding: false on all Nunito Text components for vertical centering in rounded buttons.

pares.idealPara: B2B SaaS apps, productivity tools, government and finance mobile apps, admin dashboards, enterprise onboarding
pares.notas: Single-family system: Plus Jakarta Sans balances professional authority with mobile approachability. Weight scale: ExtraBold 800 for screen titles/hero (line height 1.1–1.2). Bold 700 for section headers. SemiBold 600 for card titles and buttons. Regular 400 for body text (line height 1.4–1.5). Must support iOS Dynamic Type and Android font scaling — never hardcode pixel sizes without respecting system font scale. Button text: uppercase, letterSpacing 0.5. Caption: 12px Regular. Muted: Slate 500 #64748B.

pares.idealPara: Journaling apps, prototype tools, children's picturebook apps, creative platforms, gamified puzzle apps
pares.notas: Dual handwritten stack: Kalam Bold (700) for all headings — high visual weight, felt-tip marker aesthetic, conveys intentional messiness. Patrick Hand Regular for all body text — highly legible at mobile sizes while remaining distinctly human. Scale: Heading 28–36px with lineHeight adjusted for descenders. Body 16–18px lineHeight 1.5. Labels 14px. Vary font sizes slightly between adjacent elements for spontaneous feel. Avoid alignment: 'center' for long body text — left-aligned reads more naturally. Both fonts require useFonts loading in Expo. Never use these fonts for financial figures or legal text.

pares.idealPara: Smart home controls, minimal tools, aesthetic dashboards, health monitors, brand showcase pages
pares.notas: Single-family or System fallback: Plus Jakarta Sans Bold/Medium pairs beautifully with the monochromatic #E0E5EC surface — subtle geometry without competing with the depth effect. Heading: 24–32px Bold (700), letterSpacing -0.5 for modern premium feel. Body: 16px Medium (500), lineHeight 1.4. Caption: 12px Regular (400). Use Text Primary #3D4852 (7.5:1 contrast against #E0E5EC) for all primary text. Use Text Muted #6B7280 (4.6:1 contrast) for secondary text. Accent color #6C63FF only on active labels or focus indicators. Never use italic or thin weights — they lose legibility against the embossed background. System (SF Pro / Roboto) is an acceptable fallback for performance-sensitive implementations.

estruturas.cta: Hero (sticky) + Bottom
estruturas.cor: Hero: Brand primary or vibrant. Features: Card bg #FAFAFA. CTA: Contrasting accent color
estruturas.efeitos: Hero parallax, feature card hover lift, CTA glow on hover
estruturas.conversao: Deep CTA placement. For CTA label text, verify at least 4.5:1 against the button fill; use 7:1 only when the product explicitly targets AAA normal-text contrast. Keep focus and component boundaries independently visible. Disable hero parallax under reduced motion and render its static final state.

estruturas.cta: Hero (sticky) + Post-testimonials
estruturas.cor: Hero: Brand color. Testimonials: Light bg #F5F5F5. Quotes: Italic, muted color #666. CTA: Vibrant
estruturas.efeitos: Testimonial carousel slide animations, quote marks animations, avatar fade-in
estruturas.conversao: Social proof before CTA. Use a concise set of verified testimonials with photo, name, and role. CTA after social proof. Provide previous/next and pause controls; stop rotation on focus, hover, and reduced motion; announce slide position. Previous/next buttons and keyboard controls must expose every slide without dragging.

estruturas.cta: Video center + CTA right/bottom
estruturas.cor: Video surround: Brand color overlay. Features: Icon color #0080FF. Text: Dark #222
estruturas.efeitos: Video play button pulse, feature scroll reveals, demo interaction highlights
estruturas.conversao: Use an interactive demo only when it explains value better than static media. Provide captions, transcript, visible play/pause controls, and a non-video fallback; do not autoplay under reduced motion. Pause media when offscreen or hidden and keep the final product state available as static content.

estruturas.cta: Center, large CTA button
estruturas.cor: Minimalist: Brand + white #FFFFFF + accent. Verify CTA label text against its button fill at 4.5:1 minimum; use 7:1 only for an explicit AAA normal-text target.
estruturas.efeitos: Minimal hover effects. Smooth scroll. CTA scale on hover (subtle)
estruturas.conversao: Single CTA focus. Large typography. Lots of whitespace. No nav clutter. Mobile-first.

estruturas.cta: Each step: mini-CTA. Final: main CTA
estruturas.cor: Step colors: 1 (Red/Problem), 2 (Orange/Process), 3 (Green/Solution). CTA: Brand color
estruturas.efeitos: Step number animations, progress bar fill, step transitions smooth scroll
estruturas.conversao: Progressive disclosure. Show only essential info per step. Use progress indicators. Multiple CTAs.

estruturas.cta: Table: Right column. CTA: Below table
estruturas.cor: Table: Alternating rows (white/light grey). Your product: Highlight #FFFACD (light yellow) or green. Text: Dark
estruturas.efeitos: Table row hover highlight, price toggle animations, feature checkmark animations
estruturas.conversao: Use comparison to show unique value. Highlight your product row. Include 'free trial' in pricing row.

ordem: Lead magnet preview (ebook cover, checklist, etc)
estruturas.cta: Form CTA: Submit button
estruturas.cor: Lead magnet: Professional design. Form: Clean white bg. Inputs: Light border #CCCCCC. CTA: Brand color
estruturas.efeitos: Form focus state animations, input validation animations, success confirmation animation
estruturas.conversao: Ask only for information necessary to deliver the lead magnet. Preview its value and show submission progress.

estruturas.cta: Each card: CTA button. Sticky CTA in nav
estruturas.cor: Free: Grey, Starter: Blue, Pro: Green/Gold, Enterprise: Dark. Cards: 1px border, shadow
estruturas.efeitos: Price toggle animation (monthly/yearly), card comparison highlight, FAQ accordion open/close
estruturas.conversao: Highlight the plan that matches the intended audience and show actual annual savings transparently. Use FAQs to address concerns.

estruturas.cta: Overlay on video (center/bottom) + Bottom section
estruturas.cor: Use an overlay strong enough for text contrast. Brand accent for CTA. Light text only when the measured contrast passes.
estruturas.efeitos: Video autoplay muted, parallax scroll, text fade-in on scroll
estruturas.conversao: Use video only when it demonstrates value better than static media. Add captions for accessibility. Compress video for performance. Provide captions and a visible pause control; use a static poster when reduced motion is requested. Pause video when offscreen or hidden; the reduced-motion poster must preserve the final message and CTA.

estruturas.cta: End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA
estruturas.cor: Progressive reveal. Each chapter has distinct color. Building intensity.
estruturas.efeitos: ScrollTrigger animations, parallax layers, progressive disclosure, chapter transitions
estruturas.conversao: Keep the narrative understandable without scroll-driven effects. Use progress indicator. Mobile: simplify animations. Keep DOM reading order complete; disable parallax and scroll-scrub under reduced motion. Pause scroll animation when offscreen or hidden and render each chapter in its final readable state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Context-aware placement based on user segment
estruturas.cor: Adaptive based on user data. A/B test color variations per segment.
estruturas.efeitos: Dynamic content swap, fade transitions, personalized product recommendations
estruturas.conversao: Validate personalization with consent-aware product analytics. Requires analytics integration. Fallback for new users.

estruturas.cta: Email form prominent (above fold) + Sticky form on scroll
estruturas.cor: Anticipation: Dark + accent highlights. Countdown in brand color. Urgency indicators.
estruturas.efeitos: Countdown timer animation, email validation feedback, success confetti, social share buttons
estruturas.conversao: Explain early-access benefits without fabricated scarcity. Show a waitlist count only when it is current, verified, and dated. Provide a static launch deadline, pause decorative countdown motion when offscreen/hidden, and render the final readable timer state under reduced motion. Email form and referral actions remain keyboard operable.

estruturas.cta: After comparison table (highlighted row) + Bottom
estruturas.cor: Your product column highlighted (accent bg or green). Competitors neutral. Checkmarks green.
estruturas.efeitos: Table row hover highlight, feature checkmark animations, sticky comparison header
estruturas.conversao: Show value vs competitors. Measure comparison performance with product-specific analytics. Be factual. Include pricing if favorable.

estruturas.cta: Each pricing card + Sticky CTA in nav + Bottom
estruturas.cor: Popular plan highlighted (brand color border/bg). Free: grey. Enterprise: dark/premium.
estruturas.efeitos: Price toggle monthly/annual animation, card hover lift, FAQ accordion smooth open
estruturas.conversao: Show actual monthly and annual totals and savings transparently. Explain plan differences and address objections in the FAQ.

estruturas.cta: Download buttons prominent (App Store + Play Store) throughout
estruturas.cor: Dark/light matching app store feel. Star ratings in gold. Screenshots with device frames.
estruturas.efeitos: Device mockup rotations, screenshot slider, star rating animations, download button pulse
estruturas.conversao: Show real screenshots and only current verified ratings. Provide platform-specific CTAs, buttons and keyboard controls in addition to swipe, and pause any auto-rotation. Stop auto-rotation on focus, hover, offscreen/hidden, or reduced motion and render the selected screenshot as the static final state.

estruturas.cta: Search bar prominent + Contact CTA for unresolved questions
estruturas.cor: Clean, high readability. Minimal color. Category icons in brand color. Success green for resolved.
estruturas.efeitos: Search autocomplete, smooth accordion open/close, category hover, helpful feedback buttons
estruturas.conversao: Reduce support tickets. Track search analytics. Show related articles. Contact escalation path.

estruturas.cta: After interaction complete + Skip option for impatient users
estruturas.cor: Immersive experience colors. Dark background for focus. Highlight interactive elements.
estruturas.efeitos: WebGL, 3D interactions, gamification elements, progress indicators, reward animations
estruturas.conversao: Measure engagement for the specific audience and device mix. Performance trade-off. Provide skip option. Mobile fallback essential. Provide skip, keyboard, reduced-motion, and non-3D fallback paths. Pause animation when offscreen/hidden and preserve the completed final state when reduced motion is enabled.

estruturas.cta: Register CTA sticky + After speakers + Bottom
estruturas.cor: Urgency colors (countdown). Event branding. Speaker cards professional. Sponsor logos neutral.
estruturas.efeitos: Countdown timer, speaker hover cards with bio, agenda tabs, early bird countdown
estruturas.conversao: Early bird pricing with deadline. Social proof (past attendees). Speaker credibility. Multi-ticket discounts. Expose the exact deadline as text; pause decorative countdown motion offscreen/hidden and show a static final state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: After reviews summary + Buy button alongside reviews
estruturas.cor: Trust colors. Star ratings gold. Verified badge green. Review sentiment colors.
estruturas.efeitos: Star fill animations, review filtering, helpful vote interactions, photo lightbox
estruturas.conversao: User-generated content builds trust. Show verified purchases. Filter by rating. Respond to negative reviews.

estruturas.cta: Join button prominent + After member showcase
estruturas.cor: Warm, welcoming. Member photos add humanity. Topic badges in brand colors. Activity indicators green.
estruturas.efeitos: Member avatars animation, activity feed live updates, topic hover previews, join success celebration
estruturas.conversao: Preview real community value and simplify onboarding. Show member and activity counts only when current, verified, and dated; label activity as live only when backed by an active real-time source. Provide pause/update-frequency controls for moving feeds, stop work offscreen/hidden, and keep a static final state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: After transformation reveal + Bottom
estruturas.cor: Contrast: muted/grey (before) vs vibrant/colorful (after). Success green for results.
estruturas.efeitos: Slider comparison interaction, before/after reveal animations, result counters, testimonial videos
estruturas.conversao: Visual proof of value. Measure the outcome with product-specific analytics. Real results. Specific metrics. Guarantee offer. Provide arrow buttons and keyboard steps so dragging is not required. Arrow buttons and keyboard steps expose the same final before/after positions; reduced motion removes reveal animation.

estruturas.cta: Hero Search Bar + Navbar 'List your item'
estruturas.cor: Search: High contrast. Categories: Visual icons. Trust: Blue/Green.
estruturas.efeitos: Search autocomplete animation, map hover pins, card carousel
estruturas.conversao: Search is the primary CTA. Reduce friction with useful suggestions. For featured-listing carousels, provide previous/next and play/pause buttons, full keyboard access, and a single-pointer alternative to swiping; stop rotation on focus, hover, offscreen/hidden, or reduced motion and render the selected listing as the static final state.

estruturas.cta: Hero inline form + Sticky header form
estruturas.cor: Minimalist. Paper-like background. Text focus. Accent color for Subscribe.
estruturas.efeitos: Text highlight animations, typewriter effect, subtle fade-in
estruturas.conversao: Keep the form to the fields actually required and link to a sample issue. Show a subscriber count only when it is current, verified, and dated; otherwise use qualitative social proof.

estruturas.cta: Hero (Right side form) + Bottom anchor
estruturas.cor: Urgency: Red/Orange. Professional: Blue/Navy. Form: High contrast white.
estruturas.efeitos: Countdown timer, speaker avatar float, urgent ticker
estruturas.conversao: State the event time and timezone in text. Claim limited seats or live status only when current capacity or stream state is verified and timestamped. Provide pause/hide controls for the urgency ticker, stop it offscreen/hidden, keep controls keyboard operable, and render a static final state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Contact Sales (Primary) + Login (Secondary)
estruturas.cor: Corporate: Navy/Grey. High integrity. Conservative accents.
estruturas.efeitos: Slow video background, logo carousel, tab switching for industries
estruturas.conversao: Path selection (I am a...). Mega menu navigation. Trust signals prominent. Provide pause/stop for video and rotating logos; stop on focus and reduced motion. Logo carousel controls must be keyboard operable; pause moving media offscreen/hidden and render a static final state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Project Card Hover + Footer Contact
estruturas.cor: Neutral background (let work shine). Text: Black/White. Accent: Minimal.
estruturas.efeitos: Image lazy load reveal, hover overlay info, lightbox view
estruturas.conversao: Visuals first. Filter by category. Fast loading essential.

estruturas.cta: Floating Sticky CTA or End of Horizontal Track
estruturas.cor: Continuous palette transition. Chapter colors. Progress bar #000000.
estruturas.efeitos: Scroll-jacking (careful), parallax layers, horizontal slide, progress indicator
estruturas.conversao: Immersive product discovery. High engagement. Keep navigation visible. Preserve a normal vertical navigation path and disable scroll-jacking under reduced motion. Pause effects when offscreen/hidden and render every chapter in its final vertical reading state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Floating Action Button or Bottom of Grid
estruturas.cor: Card backgrounds: #F5F5F7 or Glass. Icons: Vibrant brand colors. Text: Dark.
estruturas.efeitos: Hover card scale (1.02), video inside cards, tilt effect, staggered reveal
estruturas.conversao: Scannable value props. High information density without clutter. Mobile stack. Keep cards usable without hover and suppress tilt/stagger/video motion under reduced motion. Pause card media offscreen/hidden and render cards in their final readable state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Inside Configurator UI + Sticky Bottom Bar
estruturas.cor: Neutral studio background. Product: Realistic materials. UI: Minimal overlay.
estruturas.efeitos: Real-time rendering, material swap animation, camera rotate/zoom, light reflection
estruturas.conversao: Let users inspect product details before purchase. Provide buttons and keyboard controls for rotate/zoom plus a 2D/specification fallback. Named rotate/zoom buttons and keyboard controls replace drag gestures; pause rendering offscreen/hidden and preserve the chosen configuration as the reduced-motion final state.

estruturas.cta: Input Field (Hero) + 'Try it' Buttons
estruturas.cor: Adaptive to user input. Dark mode for compute feel. Neon accents.
estruturas.efeitos: Typing text effects, shimmering generation loaders, morphing layouts
estruturas.conversao: Immediate value demonstration. 'Show, don't tell'. Low friction start. Disable typing, shimmer, and morphing effects when reduced motion is requested. Pause loaders offscreen/hidden and render generated content in its final state under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Hero (sticky) + After features + Bottom
estruturas.cor: Brand primary + card bg #FAFAFA. Feature icons accent. CTA contrasting.
estruturas.efeitos: Feature card hover lift, scroll reveal, icon micro-interactions
estruturas.conversao: Clear feature hierarchy. One key message per card. Strong CTA repetition.

estruturas.cta: Hero dominant (center/bottom) + Sticky nav CTA
estruturas.cor: Hero: High-impact visual. Minimal text. Verify CTA label text against the button fill at 4.5:1 minimum; use 7:1 only for an explicit AAA normal-text target.
estruturas.efeitos: Hero parallax or video, CTA pulse on scroll, minimal chrome
estruturas.conversao: One primary CTA. Let the hero dominate the initial viewport without hiding the next content cue. Use a static hero and non-pulsing CTA when reduced motion is requested; provide video controls. Pause hero media offscreen/hidden and keep the final hero message and CTA static under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Contact Sales / Get Quote (primary) + Nav
estruturas.cor: Navy/Grey corporate. Trust blue. Accent for CTA only.
estruturas.efeitos: Logo carousel, stat counters, testimonial strip
estruturas.conversao: Security badges. Case studies. Transparent pricing. Low-friction form. Provide pause/stop and stop the logo carousel on focus, hover, and reduced motion. Previous/next controls provide the keyboard equivalent; pause offscreen/hidden and render a static logo set under reduced motion.

estruturas.cta: Primary CTA in nav + After metrics
estruturas.cor: Dark or neutral. Status colors (green/amber/red). Data-dense but scannable.
estruturas.efeitos: Live data ticker, status pulse, minimal decoration
estruturas.conversao: Offer a demo or sandbox and show trust signals. Label telemetry as live only when backed by a current source, with update time and stale state. Provide pause/hide or update-frequency controls for tickers and previews, stop offscreen/hidden work, support keyboard controls, and render a static final snapshot under reduced motion.

ux.descricao: Anchor links should scroll smoothly to target section
ux.fazer: Use scroll-behavior: smooth on html element

ux.descricao: Fixed nav should not obscure content
ux.fazer: Add padding-top to body equal to nav height
ux.naoFazer: Let nav overlap first section content

ux.descricao: Current page/section should be visually indicated
ux.fazer: Highlight active nav item with color/underline
ux.naoFazer: No visual feedback on current location

ux.descricao: Users expect back to work predictably
ux.fazer: Preserve navigation history properly

ux.descricao: URLs should reflect current state for sharing
ux.fazer: Update URL on state/view changes

ux.descricao: Show user location in site hierarchy
ux.fazer: Use for sites with 3+ levels of depth

ux.descricao: Too many animations cause distraction and motion sickness
ux.fazer: Animate 1-2 key elements per view maximum

ux.descricao: Motion duration depends on distance complexity platform and user context
ux.fazer: Use shared motion tokens and test that feedback stays responsive
ux.naoFazer: Present 150-300ms or any cutoff as a universal requirement
ux.ruim: One duration copied to every transition

ux.descricao: Respect user's motion preferences
ux.fazer: Check prefers-reduced-motion media query

ux.descricao: Show feedback during async operations
ux.fazer: Use skeleton screens or spinners
ux.naoFazer: Leave UI frozen with no feedback

ux.descricao: Hover effects don't work on touch devices
ux.fazer: Use click/tap for primary interactions
ux.naoFazer: Rely only on hover for important actions

ux.descricao: Infinite animations are distracting
ux.fazer: Use for loading indicators only

ux.descricao: Some CSS properties trigger expensive repaints
ux.fazer: Use transform and opacity for animations

ux.descricao: Easing should match how an element changes speed and purpose
ux.fazer: Use deceleration when arriving acceleration when leaving and linear for constant-rate progress
ux.naoFazer: Reject linear easing even for steady rotation or progress
ux.bom: ease-out for entry; linear for spinner

ux.descricao: Stacking context conflicts cause hidden elements
ux.fazer: Define z-index scale system (10 20 30 50)

ux.descricao: Hidden overflow can clip important content
ux.fazer: Test all content fits within containers

ux.descricao: Fixed elements can overlap or be inaccessible
ux.fazer: Account for safe areas and other fixed elements
ux.bom: Fixed nav + fixed bottom with gap

ux.descricao: New stacking contexts reset z-index
ux.fazer: Understand what creates new stacking context
ux.naoFazer: Expect z-index to work across contexts

ux.descricao: Images badges validation text and skeleton replacements can shift nearby content when they update
ux.fazer: Reserve appropriate space or keep async states in a stable content-driven container
ux.naoFazer: Insert compact text or media without a layout strategy
ux.bom: aspect-ratio for media; stable count slot for badges

ux.descricao: 100vh can be problematic on mobile browsers
ux.fazer: Use dvh or account for mobile browser chrome

ux.descricao: Content too wide is hard to read
ux.fazer: Limit max-width for text content (65-75ch)
ux.naoFazer: Let text span full viewport width

ux.descricao: Touch target guidance depends on platform and web context
ux.fazer: Use 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android; for web use the separate WCAG Target Size rule
ux.naoFazer: Treat one unit or minimum as universal across platforms
ux.bom: iOS 44pt; Android 48dp; Web 24 CSS px plus WCAG exceptions

ux.descricao: Adjacent touch targets need adequate spacing
ux.fazer: Minimum 8px gap between touch targets

ux.descricao: Custom gestures can conflict with system
ux.fazer: Avoid horizontal swipe on main content

ux.descricao: 300ms tap delay feels laggy
ux.fazer: Use touch-action CSS or fastclick

ux.descricao: Accidental refresh is frustrating
ux.fazer: Disable where not needed

ux.descricao: Tactile feedback improves interaction feel
ux.fazer: Use for confirmations and important actions

ux.descricao: Keyboard focus, including controls inside a modal, needs a visible indicator
ux.fazer: Use a visible focus ring on every interactive control, including modal controls

graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Visible data table plus concise trend summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores the full range.

graficos.quando: Comparing discrete categories by magnitude; ranking or ordering is the core insight; categories ≤ 15
graficos.quandoNao: Categories > 15 (use table or search); data has time dimension (use line); showing proportions (use waffle/stacked)
graficos.volume: <20 categories: vertical bar; 20–50: horizontal bar; >50: paginated table
graficos.cor: Each bar: distinct color. Grouped: same hue family. Always sort descending by value
graficos.acessibilidade: Use direct category/value labels and group outlines or patterns; never encode category solely by bar color. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Visible sortable data table plus concise comparison summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; focusable headers with Enter/Space sort and aria-sort reports direction.

graficos.quando: ≤5 categories; one dominant segment vs rest; emphasis on visual proportion over exact values
graficos.quandoNao: Categories > 5; slice differences < 5% (visually indistinguishable); user needs precise values; accessibility-first context
graficos.volume: Max 6 slices; beyond that switch to stacked bar 100%
graficos.cor: 5–6 max colors. Contrasting palette. Largest slice at 12 o'clock. Always label slices with %
graficos.acessibilidade: Pie charts do not inherently fail WCAG; unlabeled color-only slices are inaccessible. Use direct labels and patterns, with a non-pie fallback. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Percentage data table and concise part-to-whole summary; offer a stacked bar view. Keyboard: focus reveals slice values; Enter/Space drills in; Back button returns.

graficos.quando: Exploring relationship between two continuous variables; identifying clusters or outliers in a dataset
graficos.quandoNao: Variables are categorical (use grouped bar); fewer than 20 points (patterns aren't meaningful); mobile-primary context
graficos.volume: <500 pts: SVG; 500–5000: Canvas at 0.6–0.8 opacity; >5000: hexbin or aggregate first
graficos.cor: Color axis: gradient (blue → red). Bubble size: relative to 3rd variable. Opacity: 0.6–0.8 to show density
graficos.acessibilidade: Combine marker shapes with direct group labels; color may reinforce but must not be the only distinction.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Visible data table plus correlation summary. Keyboard: focus reveals point values; labeled start/end range inputs replace brush dragging.

graficos.quando: Showing intensity/density across a 2D grid; time-based patterns (e.g., activity by hour × day)
graficos.quandoNao: Fewer than 20 cells (use bar); user needs to read exact values; colorblind users without pattern fallback
graficos.volume: Up to 10,000 cells efficiently; beyond that aggregate; calendar heatmap: 365 cells max per SVG
graficos.cor: Gradient: Cool (blue) to Hot (red). Divergent scale for ±data. Always include numeric color legend
graficos.acessibilidade: Print values or symbols in cells and use texture/labels in addition to the color scale. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Grid data table plus intensity summary. Keyboard: focus reveals cell values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores the grid.

graficos.quando: Data has a regional/location dimension; spatial distribution is the core insight for the user
graficos.quandoNao: Regions have very different sizes making visual comparison misleading (use bar); mobile-primary context
graficos.volume: <1000 regions: SVG; ≥1000: Canvas/WebGL (Deck.gl); global maps: tile-based rendering
graficos.cor: Single color gradient per region group. Categorized colors for discrete types. Legend with clear scale breaks
graficos.acessibilidade: Label regions directly and pair fills with boundaries or patterns; location meaning cannot depend on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Sortable region table plus geographic summary. Keyboard: arrow keys or labeled pan buttons move the map; +/- buttons zoom; Enter drills into a focused region; Back returns.

graficos.quando: Sequential multi-stage process; showing conversion or drop-off rates between defined stages
graficos.quandoNao: Stages aren't sequential; values don't decrease monotonically (use bar); fewer than 3 stages
graficos.volume: 3–8 stages optimal; beyond 8 stages group minor steps into 'Other'
graficos.cor: Stages: single color gradient (start → end). Show conversion % between each stage. Highlight biggest drop
graficos.acessibilidade: Keep stage names and values visible and distinguish stages with text and boundaries, not only a gradient. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Linear stage table/list plus conversion summary. Keyboard: focus reveals stage values; Enter/Space drills in; Back returns.

graficos.quando: Single KPI measured against a defined target or threshold; dashboard summary context
graficos.quandoNao: No target or benchmark exists; comparing multiple KPIs at once (use bullet chart grid)
graficos.volume: Single metric per gauge; for 3+ KPIs use bullet chart grid layout
graficos.cor: Performance: Red → Yellow → Green gradient. Target: marker line. Threshold zones clearly differentiated
graficos.acessibilidade: Place the number and target text beside the gauge and label threshold zones; red/yellow/green alone is insufficient.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Visible KPI/target text and a one-row data table plus status summary. Keyboard: focus reveals the same detail as hover.

graficos.quando: Historical data + model predictions; communicating uncertainty range to non-technical stakeholders
graficos.quandoNao: No historical baseline; prediction confidence is too low to be useful; audience is not data-literate
graficos.volume: Keep historical window to 30–90 days for readability; forecast horizon ≤ 30% of visible x-axis range
graficos.cor: Actual: solid line #0080FF. Forecast: dashed #FF9500. Confidence band: 15% opacity fill same hue
graficos.acessibilidade: Use solid actual and dashed forecast lines, direct labels, and a named confidence range; hue alone is insufficient.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Visible forecast table plus uncertainty summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; buttons toggle actual/forecast; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores range.

graficos.quando: Monitoring a time-series for outliers; alerting users to unexpected spikes or dips in operational data
graficos.quandoNao: Anomalies are predefined categories (use bar with highlight); real-time context without a pause control
graficos.volume: Stream at ≤60fps with Canvas; batch: up to 10,000 pts; mark anomalies as a separate data layer
graficos.cor: Normal: #0080FF solid line. Anomaly marker: #FF0000 circle + filled. Alert band: #FFF3CD background zone
graficos.acessibilidade: Mark anomalies with a distinct shape and text annotation as well as color. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Anomaly event list/table plus narrative alert summary. Keyboard: focus reveals point details; alerts are available in the persistent list without hover.

graficos.quando: Showing size relationships within a hierarchy; overview of proportional structure (e.g., budget breakdown)
graficos.quandoNao: Hierarchy depth > 3 levels (too complex to read); user needs to compare sibling values precisely
graficos.volume: <200 nodes: SVG; 200–1000: Canvas; >1000: paginate or pre-filter before rendering
graficos.cor: Parent nodes: distinct hues. Children: lighter shades of same hue. White separator borders: 2–3px
graficos.acessibilidade: Label hierarchy nodes and use borders/patterns as well as hue; make the tree table the primary accessible view. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Collapsible tree table plus hierarchy summary; treemap remains supplementary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; Enter/Space drills or expands; Back collapses/returns.

graficos.quando: Showing how quantities flow between nodes; multi-source multi-target distribution
graficos.quandoNao: Flow directions form loops (use network graph); fewer than 3 source-target pairs; mobile-primary context
graficos.volume: <50 flows: SVG; ≥50: Canvas; >200 flows: aggregate minor flows into 'Other' node
graficos.cor: Gradient from source to target color. Flow opacity: 0.4–0.6. Node labels always visible
graficos.acessibilidade: Label source, target, and value; use line style or node symbols in addition to gradient color. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Source-to-target flow table plus flow summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; Enter/Space drills into a node; Back returns.

graficos.quando: Showing how individual positive/negative components add up to a final total (e.g., P&L, budget variance)
graficos.quandoNao: Changes are not additive; more than 12 bars (readability breaks); audience expects a simple total
graficos.volume: 4–12 bars optimal; beyond 12 aggregate minor items into a single 'Other' bar
graficos.cor: Increases: #4CAF50. Decreases: #F44336. Start total: #2196F3. End total: #0D47A1. Running total line: dashed
graficos.acessibilidade: Pair increase/decrease bars with signed values and directional icons, not red/green alone. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Running-total table plus variance summary. Keyboard: focus reveals the same value as hover.

graficos.quando: Comparing multiple entities across the same fixed set of attributes (e.g., product feature comparison)
graficos.quandoNao: Axes > 8 (unreadable); values need precise comparison (use grouped bar); audience unfamiliar with radar charts
graficos.volume: 2–3 datasets maximum per chart; 5–8 axes; beyond 8 axes switch to parallel coordinates
graficos.cor: Single dataset: #0080FF at 20% fill. Multiple: distinct hues with 30% fill. Border: full opacity
graficos.acessibilidade: Use line styles, point shapes, and direct series labels in addition to color. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Raw data table and grouped-bar alternative plus comparison summary. Keyboard: focus reveals values; buttons toggle series.

graficos.quando: Financial time-series with Open/High/Low/Close data; trading or investment product context only
graficos.quandoNao: Non-financial audience; no OHLC data available (use line chart); accessibility-first context
graficos.volume: Real-time: Canvas required. Historical: paginate by time range. Max 500 candles visible at once
graficos.cor: Bullish: #26A69A. Bearish: #EF5350. Volume bars: 40% opacity below. Body fill vs hollow for OHLC style
graficos.acessibilidade: Use filled versus hollow candles and OHLC text values; bullish/bearish meaning cannot depend on color. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Sortable OHLC table plus daily-change summary. Keyboard: focus reveals candle values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores range; live updates do not steal focus.

graficos.quando: Mapping connections between entities; network topology or social graph exploration context
graficos.quandoNao: Node count > 500 without clustering pre-applied; user needs precise connection counts; mobile context
graficos.volume: ≤100 nodes: SVG; 101–500: Canvas; >500: must apply clustering/LOD before rendering
graficos.cor: Node types: categorical colors. Edges: #90A4AE at 60% opacity. Highlight path: #F59E0B
graficos.acessibilidade: Use labeled node types, shapes, and edge styles in addition to color; the adjacency view is the accessible source of truth. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Adjacency list/table and relationship summary; tree view when applicable. Keyboard: focus reveals node details; Enter drills; Move up/down/left/right buttons replace drag.

graficos.quando: Showing spread, median, and outliers of a dataset; comparing distributions across multiple groups
graficos.quandoNao: Fewer than 20 data points per group (distribution is not meaningful); audience unfamiliar with statistical charts
graficos.volume: Any sample size; aggregated representation so rendering is ⚡ Excellent at any volume
graficos.cor: Box fill: #BBDEFB. Border: #1976D2. Median line: #D32F2F bold. Outlier dots: #F44336
graficos.acessibilidade: Label median, quartiles, whiskers, and outliers directly; do not use color alone for statistical roles.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Statistics table plus distribution summary. Keyboard: focus reveals the same statistics as hover.

graficos.quando: Dashboard with multiple KPIs side by side; space-constrained contexts where a gauge is too large
graficos.quandoNao: Single KPI with emphasis (use gauge); data has no defined target range; fewer than 3 KPIs
graficos.volume: Ideal for 3–10 bullet charts in a grid; scales to any count efficiently
graficos.cor: Qualitative ranges: #FFCDD2 / #FFF9C4 / #C8E6C9 (bad/ok/good). Performance bar: #1976D2. Target: black 3px marker
graficos.acessibilidade: Label every qualitative range and target with text; color is supplementary.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Visible KPI/target table plus status summary. Keyboard: focus reveals the same detail as hover.

graficos.quando: Showing what fraction of a whole is filled; percentage progress in a visually engaging and accessible format
graficos.quandoNao: More than 5 categories (use stacked bar); exact values matter over visual proportion; very tight space
graficos.volume: 10×10 grid standard (100 cells); for > 5 categories switch to stacked 100% bar
graficos.cor: 3–5 categories max. 2–3px gap between cells. Each category a distinct accessible color pair
graficos.acessibilidade: Label each category and percentage and add patterns or symbols; filled-cell color alone is insufficient.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Percentage table/list plus part-to-whole summary. Keyboard: focus reveals each cell value.

graficos.quando: Exploring nested proportions where both hierarchy and relative size matter (e.g., org spend breakdown)
graficos.quandoNao: More than 3 hierarchy levels (outer rings become unreadable); precision matters over overview; mobile
graficos.volume: <100 nodes: SVG; 100–500: Canvas; >500: filter to top N before rendering
graficos.cor: Center to outer: darker to lighter hue. Each level 15–20% lighter. Contrasting border between sectors
graficos.acessibilidade: Label hierarchy levels and segments and use boundaries/patterns as well as hue; the indented list is primary. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Collapsible indented list/table plus hierarchy summary and breadcrumbs. Keyboard: Enter/Space drills or expands; Back button returns; focus reveals hover detail.

graficos.quando: Decomposing a metric into contributing factors; AI-assisted analysis or BI drill-down scenarios
graficos.quandoNao: No clear parent-child causal relationship; audience expects a summary rather than exploration
graficos.volume: Up to 5 levels deep; limit visible nodes to 20 per level for readability; lazy-load deeper levels
graficos.cor: Positive impact nodes: #2563EB. Negative impact nodes: #EF4444. Neutral connectors: #94A3B8
graficos.acessibilidade: Name each node and contribution and use shapes/connector styles in addition to color. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Expandable tree table plus root-cause summary. Keyboard: Enter/Space drills and expands; Back collapses; dedicated expand/collapse buttons expose the same operations.

graficos.quando: Scientific/engineering context where Z-axis carries essential info not expressible in 2D
graficos.quandoNao: 2D projection conveys the same insight; mobile context; accessibility-required environments; standard business dashboards
graficos.volume: WebGL required. Deck.gl: up to 1M points. Three.js: LOD required beyond 50,000 pts
graficos.cor: Depth cues: lighting and shading. Z-axis: color gradient (cool → warm). Transparent overlapping: opacity 0.4
graficos.acessibilidade: Use labels, shapes, and depth-independent cues; color and 3D position cannot be the only carriers of meaning.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Mandatory 2D projection, data table, and spatial summary. Keyboard: rotate/pan buttons and +/- zoom controls replace pointer/VR manipulation; Reset returns the camera.

graficos.quando: Live monitoring dashboards; IoT/ops data updating at ≥1 Hz; user needs current value at a glance
graficos.quandoNao: Update frequency < 1/min (use periodic-refresh line chart); flashing content without reduced-motion support
graficos.volume: Canvas/WebGL required. Buffer last 60–300s of data. Downsample older data on scroll
graficos.cor: Current pulse: #00FF00 (dark theme) or #0080FF (light theme). History: fading opacity. Grid: dark background
graficos.acessibilidade: Show the current value and status text and use line styles or markers in addition to color. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Streaming data table plus current-value/trend summary. Keyboard: Pause/Resume button controls updates; focus reveals values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores range.

graficos.quando: NLP output visualization; exploratory analysis of text corpus sentiment; frequency-weighted keyword overview
graficos.quandoNao: Precise values matter (word size is inherently imprecise); screen-reader context; corpus < 50 items
graficos.volume: 50–5000 terms optimal. Beyond 5000: apply top-N filtering before render. Avoid on mobile
graficos.cor: Positive: #22C55E. Negative: #EF4444. Neutral: #94A3B8. Word size maps to frequency
graficos.acessibilidade: Expose every term, count, and sentiment as text; size and color are supplementary only.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Sortable term table/list plus sentiment summary; word cloud is supplementary. Keyboard: focus reveals word details; labeled controls filter with Space/Enter.

graficos.quando: Analyzing event logs to visualize actual process flows; identifying bottlenecks and deviations in ops/product funnels
graficos.quandoNao: No event log data available; audience expects a static flowchart (use diagram tool); node count > 100 without pre-filtering
graficos.volume: <30 nodes: SVG; 30–100: Canvas; >100: apply variant filtering (top 80% of cases) before rendering
graficos.cor: Happy path: #10B981 thick line. Deviations: #F59E0B thin line. Bottleneck nodes: #EF4444 fill
graficos.acessibilidade: Label nodes and paths and use shapes/line styles in addition to color; bottlenecks require text annotations. Do not rely on color alone.
graficos.alternativaAcessivel: Path summary table plus bottleneck narrative. Keyboard: Move buttons replace drag; focus reveals node details; Enter activates a node; Back returns.
